summary_brief: 2026年3月6日是 AI 编程工具生态的重大升级日。OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-5.4 模型，十余个主流工具（Cline、gptme、Zed、OpenCode 等）同日完成集成，标志着新一代大模型全面进入生产环境。同时，MCP/ACP 标准化协议、安全沙箱隔离、多 Agent UI 等技术方向呈现明显的行业协同演进趋势。

engineering_signals.title: GPT-5.4 模型生态全面集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 新一代 GPT-5.4 模型同日被十余个 AI 编程工具集成，标志着从 GPT-5.3 到 5.4 的代际升级完成，codex 变体被设为推荐模型暗示代码能力显著提升，将直接影响开发者的 AI 辅助编程体验。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 通信协议标准化（MCP + ACP 双轨并行）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: MCP Elicitation 和 ACP 执行模式在同一天被 OpenAI Codex、Gemini CLI、gptme 等多个工具实现，表明 AI 工具间的标准化通信协议正在快速普及，为未来多 Agent 协作生态奠定基础。

engineering_signals.title: AI 工具安全隔离机制升级
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 原生集成 gVisor 沙箱，RuFlo 实施多项安全修复，多个项目快速响应 CVE 漏洞，反映了 AI 编程工具行业对安全性的高度重视，为 AI 自动执行代码提供了系统级保障。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent Hooks 机制标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 引入 Notification hook 和 --hooks-dir 运行时注入机制，为 AI Agent 提供可扩展的事件驱动架构，便于外部系统集成和构建复杂自动化工作流，代表了 Agent 可观测性和可控性的重要进展。

engineering_signals.title: 多 Agent UI 与 IDE 深度集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 实现全新的 Multi Agent UI，Claude Code 新增 VS Code 原生集成功能（会话管理面板、MCP 服务器管理），表明 AI 编程助手正在从单点工具向 IDE 深度嵌入的协作平台演进。

engineering_signals.title: 上下文管理与 Token 经济优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 新增上下文窗口利用率可视化、目录列表截断、二进制文件元数据处理等功能，Claude Code 大幅优化性能，反映了 AI 工具在长对话场景下对 Token 预算管理的精细化趋势。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 评估框架多维度演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain DeepAgents 将评估断言拆分为正确性和效率两个层级，gptme 扩展评估套件覆盖 JSON 处理、多文件重构等真实场景，推动 AI Agent 评估从单一指标向多维度精细化发展。

engineering_signals.title: 运行时从 Bun 向 Node.js 迁移趋势
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 系统性将 Bun 特定 API 替换为 Node.js 标准实现，反映部分 AI 工具项目在追求跨平台兼容性和生态系统稳定性时，选择回归更成熟的 Node.js 运行时。

release_signals.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.4 模型
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-5.4 模型，同时推出新的 tool search tool 和 computer tool，标志着 AI 编程助手能力的重大升级。多个工具（OpenAI Python SDK、Zed 编辑器、OpenCode）已同步支持。

release_signals.title: Claude Code VS Code 深度集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 新增 VS Code 原生集成功能，包括会话管理面板、Markdown 计划文档视图和原生 MCP 服务器管理对话框，大幅提升 IDE 内 AI 辅助开发体验。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 默认启用 Fast 模式
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 将 Fast 模式设为默认，TUI 头部显示会话运行模式，同时支持动态导入本地 JS/MJS 文件，提升开发效率和灵活性。

release_signals.title: RuFlo 安全加固与跨平台支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: RuFlo v3.5.14 实施多项安全修复（防止命令注入、缓冲区限制、输入验证），并完善 Windows 跨平台 Hook 支持，通过 1600 项测试验证。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 支持视频多模态输入
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain DeepAgents CLI 新增视频多模态输入支持，同时添加 NVIDIA API 密钥支持和模糊搜索自动补全功能，扩展了 Agent 的感知能力。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 性能大幅优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code v2.1.70 将提示输入重渲染减少 74%，启动内存减少 426KB，远程控制轮询频率降低 300 倍，显著提升响应速度和资源效率。

release_signals.title: OpenCode 从 Bun 迁移至 Node.js
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 将核心运行时从 Bun 迁移到 Node.js（stdin 读取、文件系统、哈希、网络连接等），提升跨平台兼容性和稳定性。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Fixed API 400 errors when using `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` with a third-party gateway — tool search now correctly detects proxy endpoints and disables `tool_reference` blocks
- Fixed `API Error: 400 This model does not support the effort parameter` when using custom Bedrock inference profiles or other model identifiers not matching standard Claude naming patterns
- Fixed empty model responses immediately after `ToolSearch` — the server renders tool schemas with system-prompt-style tags at the prompt tail, which could confuse models into stopping early
- Fixed prompt-cache bust when an MCP server with `instructions` connects after the first turn
- Fixed Enter inserting a newline instead of submitting when typing over a slow SSH connection
- Fixed clipboard corrupting non-ASCII text (CJK, emoji) on Windows/WSL by using PowerShell `Set-Clipboard`
- Fixed extra VS Code windows opening at startup on Windows when running from the VS Code integrated terminal
- Fixed voice mode failing on Windows native binary with "native audio module could not be loaded"
- Fixed push-to-talk not activating on session start when `voiceEnabled: true` was set in settings
- Fixed markdown links containing `#NNN` references incorrectly pointing to the current repository instead of the linked URL
- Fixed repeated "Model updated to Opus 4.6" notification when a project's `.claude/settings.json` has a legacy Opus model string pinned
- Fixed plugins showing as inaccurately installed in `/plugin`
- Fixed plugins showing "not found in marketplace" errors on fresh startup by auto-refreshing after marketplace installation
- Fixed `/security-review` command failing with `unknown option merge-base` on older git versions
- Fixed `/color` command having no way to reset back to the default color — `/color default`, `/color gray`, `/color reset`, and `/color none` now restore the default
- Fixed a performance regression in the `AskUserQuestion` preview dialog that re-ran markdown rendering on every keystroke in the notes input
- Fixed feature flags read during early startup never refreshing their disk cache, causing stale values to persist across sessions
- Fixed `permissions.defaultMode` settings values other than `acceptEdits` or `plan` being applied in Claude Code Remote environments — they are now ignored
- Fixed skill listing being re-injected on every `--resume` (~600 tokens saved per resume)
- Fixed teleport marker not rendering in VS Code teleported sessions
- Improved error message when microphone captures silence to distinguish from "no speech detected"
- Improved compaction to preserve images in the summarizer request, allowing prompt cache reuse for faster and cheaper compaction
- Improved `/rename` to work while Claude is processing, instead of being silently queued
- Reduced prompt input re-renders during turns by ~74%
- Reduced startup memory by ~426KB for users without custom CA certificates
- Reduced Remote Control `/poll` rate to once per 10 minutes while connected (was 1–2s), cutting server load ~300×. Reconnection is unaffected — transport loss immediately wakes fast polling.
- [VSCode] Added spark icon in VS Code activity bar that lists all Claude Code sessions, with sessions opening as full editors
- [VSCode] Added full markdown document view for plans in VS Code, with support for adding comments to provide feedback
- [VSCode] Added native MCP server management dialog — use `/mcp` in the chat panel to enable/disable servers, reconnect, and manage OAuth authentication without switching to the terminal

key_changes: 修复第三方 API 网关和自定义 Bedrock 模型的 400 错误问题
修复 Windows 平台的剪贴板乱码、VS Code 多窗口、语音模式等多项问题
修复 MCP 服务器连接后导致 prompt cache 失效的问题
修复插件管理相关的显示和启动错误
修复 /color、/security-review 等命令的功能缺陷
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本是一个错误修复版本，主要解决了 API 兼容性问题（第三方网关和自定义 Bedrock 模型）、Windows 平台的多项稳定性问题（剪贴板、VS Code 集成、语音模式），以及插件管理和多个斜杠命令的功能缺陷。此次更新提升了与第三方服务的兼容性和 Windows 平台的用户体验。

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
## v3.5.14 (2026-03-06)

### Security Fixes (ADR-061)
- **S-1**: Replace `execSync` with `execFileSync` to prevent command injection in GCS storage
- **S-2**: Add `MAX_BUFFER` constant (10MB) to prevent unbounded stdout capture
- **S-3**: Add `validatePackageName()` to sanitize plugin names before shell use
- **S-4**: Add IPFS CID format validation before network requests
- **S-5**: Add buffer size limits to all `execSync` calls

### Correctness Fixes (ADR-061)
- **D-1**: Fix CFP magic-number check (use `subarray`, not `slice`)
- **D-2**: Fix unsupported format error (throw instead of silent fallback)
- **D-3**: Fix MCP partial-JSON accumulator (per-session buffering)
- **D-4**: Fix duplicate provider registration guard
- **D-5**: Fix memory namespace parameter passthrough
- **D-6**: Fix process command error handler (use `err.message`)
- **D-7**: Fix GCS credential loading (resolve path, validate fields)

### Cross-Platform Windows Hooks (ADR-062)
- Hook commands use `node script subcommand` (no shell quoting issues)
- `cmd /c` prefix on Windows bypasses PowerShell stdin pipe hanging
- StatusLine uses plain `node` (no `cmd /c`) for proper stdin forwarding
- 500ms stdin timeout prevents Windows hanging
- `process.exitCode = 0` guaranteed in all hook scripts
- Fix invalid `SubagentEnd` → `SubagentStop` hook event name
- Restore valid `SubagentStart` hook event

### Testing
- 1600 tests passed across 23 test suites
- 10 new deep test suites covering security, plugins, MCP tools, memory, CLI parsing

### Packages
| Package | Version | Install |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `@claude-flow/cli` | 3.5.14 | `npx @claude-flow/cli@latest` |
| `claude-flow` | 3.5.14 | `npx claude-flow@latest` |
| `ruflo` | 3.5.14 | `npx ruflo@latest` |

### Upgrade
```bash
npx ruflo@latest init
# or
npx claude-flow@latest init
```

This regenerates `.claude/settings.json` with cross-platform hook commands.

## What's New in v3.5.5–v3.5.7

Three releases addressing platform parity, branding consistency, and hook reliability:

### v3.5.7 — Hook Stdin Timeout Fix
- **Fixed**: `hook-handler.cjs` stdin hanging when Claude Code leaves stdin in ambiguous state (not TTY, not proper pipe)
- **Fix**: Replaced `for await` with event-based reading + 500ms `setTimeout` fallback
- Affects: All hook invocations (pre-bash, post-edit, route, session-restore, etc.)

- **Fixed**: Settings-generator missing 4 hooks (#1291) — added PostToolUse:Bash, PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit, SubagentEnd, Notification
- **Fixed**: Daemon header shows "Worker Daemon" → "RuFlo Daemon"

### v3.5.5 — Complete Branding Sweep
- Replaced all "Claude Flow V3" → "RuFlo V3" across **30+ files**
- Covers: CLI source, shell helpers, statusline, config templates, JSDoc, SQL schema, plugin descriptions
- Windows-specific: PS1 daemon manager, BAT wrapper, status scripts

### Infrastructure
- Added Nginx reverse proxy to RuFlo Chat UI docker-compose for branding injection and CORS

### ADR-060 Progress
- **13/24 items fixed** — all P0 and P1 resolved
- Remaining: 4 P2 + 6 P3 (non-critical)

## RuFlo v3.5.3

Patch release addressing 11 issues from ADR-059 bug triage, branding updates, and stale code cleanup.

### Bug Fixes

#### P0 — Critical
- **Removed obfuscated preinstall script** (#1261) — supply-chain security risk eliminated
- **RVF ObjectId cross-package matching** (#1297) — conversation lookups now return correct data

#### P1 — High
- **Hooks path resolution** (#1259, #1284) — all hook commands use `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` for absolute paths
- **AgentDB ControllerRegistry wiring** (#1264) — ReasoningBank, SkillLibrary, ExplainableRecall now active at runtime
- **MCP array schema compliance** (#1294) — 13 schemas fixed with `items` field across 7 tool files

#### P2 — Medium
- **MCP version string** (#1253) — reads from `package.json` at runtime instead of hardcoded `3.0.0-alpha`
- **MCP branding** (#1280) — identifies as `ruflo` instead of `claude-flow`
- **Statusline branding** (#1254) — `Claude Flow V3` → `RuFlo V3`
- **Chat UI web_search** — empty query validation prevents 400 errors
- **Chat UI settings dedup** — removes duplicate settings entries on startup

### Branding
- Statusline: `Claude Flow V3` → `RuFlo V3` (single-line and multi-line modes)
- 20+ CLI command files updated: `Claude Flow V3` → `RuFlo V3`
- README title updated to `RuFlo v3.5`
- Settings version: `3.0.0` → `3.5.2`

### Cleanup
- Removed `docs/ruvector-postgres/` (superseded by AgentDB)
- Removed `packages/coflow/` (superseded by `@claude-flow/cli`)

### npm Packages

| Package | Version | Install |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `@claude-flow/cli` | 3.5.3 | `npx @claude-flow/cli@latest` |
| `claude-flow` | 3.5.3 | `npx claude-flow@latest` |
| `ruflo` | 3.5.3 | `npx ruflo@latest` |

### Validation

All fixes verified via Docker regression testing:
- ✅ TypeScript compilation clean
- ✅ Docker build succeeds
- ✅ Conversation isolation (distinct IDs return distinct data)
- ✅ MCP bridge healthy
- ✅ Empty web_search handled gracefully
- ✅ All static assets return 200

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/compare/v3.5.2...v3.5.3

key_changes: 移除了混淆的 preinstall 脚本，消除供应链安全风险（#1261）
修复 RVF ObjectId 跨包匹配问题，会话查询现返回正确数据（#1297）
统一品牌标识从 Claude Flow V3 更名为 RuFlo V3
修复 Hooks 路径解析，所有 hook 命令现使用绝对路径
修复 MCP array schema 合规性问题，13 个 schema 已修正
ai_summary.summary_cn: RuFlo v3.5.3 是一个补丁版本，修复了 11 个问题，涵盖安全漏洞修复、功能 bug 修复和品牌更新。最重要的变更是移除了存在供应链安全风险的混淆 preinstall 脚本，并修复了 RVF ObjectId 跨包匹配问题。同时完成了从 Claude Flow V3 到 RuFlo V3 的品牌重塑，以及清理了过时代码。
